=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:98 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The script unconditionally logs `claimed` after a failed claim POST, producing success-shaped telemetry for an issue that was not claimed.
  WHY: Operators and log scrapers can interpret the contractual `CLAUDE_ISSUE_HANDOFF claimed` signal as success despite dispatch being skipped; severity is highest, with openai_gpt-6-luna rating it NIT and the other reviewers rating it MAJOR.
- tests/test_claude_issue_route.py:363-385 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The failed-claim test does not assert that the contradictory `claimed` log line is absent.
  WHY: The test can pass while the success-shaped telemetry regression remains, so it does not enforce the stated failure-path invariant.
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:88-97 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Stale-label cleanup runs even after the claim POST fails, removing labels from an issue the script could not claim.
  WHY: This can remove labels such as `ai:blocked` or `ai:clarification` from an unclaimed issue; severity is highest, with deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro labeling it MIT and google_gemini-3_8-flash including it in a MAJOR finding.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The handoff claim is mandatory (`scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`). If the `ai:claude` POST fails, no dispatch is sent and the existing `ai:claude-handoff-failed` path runs, with wording that names the cause.
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh, around the unconditional `log "claimed issue=…"` line (line 98); tests/test_claude_issue_route.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The `claimed` log remains unconditional when `CLAIM_OK` is false; `test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim` asserts failure logs and absence of dispatch, but never asserts that the `claimed` log is absent.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:98 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `claimed` log runs unconditionally after the claim-label POST block, even when `CLAIM_OK` is false.
  WHY: Log scrapers can report an issue as claimed when it was never claimed.
- tests/test_claude_issue_route.py:363-385 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The failed-claim test does not assert that the `claimed` log line is absent.
  WHY: The test does not enforce the invariant that a failed claim POST produces no success telemetry.
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:88-97 | severity=MIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Stale-label cleanup runs after the claim POST fails and can remove labels from an issue that was not successfully claimed.
  WHY: Removing `ai:blocked` or `ai:clarification` is a non-reversible side effect.
- Requirement: PR description "The handoff claim is mandatory (`scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`). If the `ai:claude` POST fails, no dispatch is sent and the existing `ai:claude-handoff-failed` path runs, with wording that names the cause."
  Expected change site: scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh line 98, the unconditional `log "claimed issue=..."` line
  Evidence of absence: The diff hunk `@@ -96,7 +102,9 @@` adds lines below the existing `claimed` log but does not modify the log itself. The test `test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim` asserts on `error claim_label_failed`, `error dispatch_failed`, and the absence of `dispatches` / `ai:claude-issue-routed:v1`, but never asserts that the `claimed` log line is absent.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:lines 88-98 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Stale-label removal and the `claimed` log run unconditionally even when the `ai:claude` label POST fails.
  WHY: This emits contradictory success telemetry before the dispatch failure path and performs unnecessary stale-label deletions.
- Requirement: The handoff claim is mandatory (scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh). If the ai:claude POST fails, no dispatch is sent and the existing ai:claude-handoff-failed path runs, with wording that names the cause.
  Expected change site: scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh lines 88-98
  Evidence of absence: While dispatch execution is skipped when CLAIM_OK is false, the claim step does not treat claim failure as an immediate transition to the failure path; lines 88-98 still execute the stale label removal loop and unconditionally emit log "claimed issue=..." rather than gating claim completion and telemetry on CLAIM_OK="true". In addition, test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim in tests/test_claude_issue_route.py asserts error log lines but fails to assert that the contradictory claimed log line is absent.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh:Line 98 — `log "claimed issue=${ISSUE_NUMBER} trigger=${TRIGGER} reason=${ROUTE_REASON}"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `claimed` log is unconditional after a failed `ai:claude` label POST.
  WHY: Operators and log scrapers can observe an issue reported as claimed despite the failed claim and skipped dispatch; the contract test does not assert that the `claimed` line is absent.
- Requirement: PR description — "The handoff claim is mandatory (`scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`). If the `ai:claude` POST fails, no dispatch is sent and the existing `ai:claude-handoff-failed` path runs, with wording that names the cause." Plus checklist row "Handoff never dispatches without the claim" (status: complete; covered by `test_handoff_does_not_dispatch_an_issue_it_could_not_claim`).
  Expected change site: `scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh` around the unconditional `log "claimed issue=…"` line (new line 98, old line 96). The log must be gated on `CLAIM_OK` (or moved below the dispatch conditional) so the failure path emits no success-shaped telemetry.
  Evidence of absence: The diff hunk `@@ -96,7 +102,9 @@ log "claimed issue=…"` only inserts the `if/elif` for `CLAIM_OK` around `build-dispatch`; the `claimed` log itself is not modified and remains unconditional. The PR's contract test does not assert against the `claimed` line being absent on the failure path, so the regression is shipped and uncaught by the new test surface.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
